{
  "policy": {
    "open_requests_require_finite_reevaluation": true,
    "open_requests_require_safe_alternative_work": true,
    "project_waiting_is_stop_condition": false,
    "review_each_root_cycle": true,
    "secrets_allowed": false
  },
  "requests": [
    {
      "created_at": "2026-08-22T12:58:24Z",
      "id": "independent-production-evaluator-access-v1",
      "kind": "environment",
      "last_reviewed_at": "2026-09-05T11:11:08.725905Z",
      "non_blocking": true,
      "previous_review": {
        "reason": "The external ledger currently has zero evaluation requests, challenges, disclosures, attestations, and registered verifiers; internal evidence cannot fill this gap.",
        "reevaluate_by": "2026-08-23T12:58:24Z"
      },
      "priority": "helpful",
      "reason": "Exact main has one evaluation request and zero challenges, disclosures, attestations and registered verifiers. A prepared request does not supply independent evaluation or production results.",
      "reevaluate_by": "2026-09-06T11:11:08.725923Z",
      "reevaluate_on": "A verifier registers, an independently controlled production route becomes available without user action, or the next Root strategy review occurs.",
      "requested_user_action": "If available, authorize or identify an independently controlled production environment and evaluator/attestor outside this repository and operator. Do not paste credentials or secrets; use an approved connection or secret-management channel.",
      "review_evidence_ref": "artifacts/unit-generation30-execution-route-review-v1/result.json",
      "safe_alternative_work": [
        "Continue the exact frozen native lifecycle through protected publication.",
        "Compare materially different methods using primary-source evidence and prospectively specified mechanical evaluation.",
        "Observe independently controlled evaluation routes without creating a self-attestor."
      ],
      "status": "open",
      "summary": "Independent production evaluator and attestor access would directly shorten the strict gate path."
    },
    {
      "created_at": "2026-08-22T12:58:24Z",
      "id": "secure-live-provider-capacity-v1",
      "kind": "environment",
      "last_reviewed_at": "2026-09-05T11:11:08.725905Z",
      "non_blocking": true,
      "previous_review": {
        "reason": "The retained Copilot workflow 32094156066 exhausted its monthly quota; the existing alternate-provider route must not assume credentials that are not observable.",
        "reevaluate_by": "2026-08-23T12:58:24Z"
      },
      "priority": "helpful",
      "reason": "Historical run32094156066 from 2026-08-18 retained quota exhaustion. Current September provider capacity is unverified, so that old failure must not be treated as current exhaustion. Existing workflow definitions expose a route but do not prove credential or capacity readiness.",
      "reevaluate_by": "2026-09-06T11:11:08.725923Z",
      "reevaluate_on": "A provider-capacity signal becomes observable, an existing fallback route proves usable without user action, or the next Root strategy review occurs.",
      "requested_user_action": "If desired, configure an approved provider credential through the repository or platform secret-management UI, or authorize an already connected provider. Never paste a key into chat, source, logs, or this queue.",
      "review_evidence_ref": "artifacts/unit-generation30-execution-route-review-v1/result.json",
      "safe_alternative_work": [
        "Complete the current frozen native lifecycle.",
        "Audit author-released repair evidence and prepare a bounded matched comparison without a live provider call.",
        "Recheck a concrete provider-readiness signal at Root before selecting a live trial."
      ],
      "status": "open",
      "summary": "A securely configured live model provider could unblock independent live semantic trials."
    }
  ],
  "revision": 1,
  "schema_version": 1,
  "updated_at": "2026-09-05T11:11:08.725905Z"
}

{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "evaluation_requests": [
    {
      "claim_boundary": "This manifest is a request for independently controlled production evaluation. It is not an attestation, a production result, or AGI evidence. A claim remains blocked until the external ledger passes provenance audit, the strict two-group quorum is met for every criterion, each signed attestation reports the same observed runtime-system manifest bound by the request, and the conservative core evaluation policy passes with no unresolved blocking production failures.",
      "core_evaluation_policy": {
        "disallow_unresolved_production_failures": true,
        "min_distinct_domains_per_criterion": 2,
        "min_distinct_independent_attestors_per_criterion": 1,
        "min_distinct_runs_per_criterion": 2,
        "min_distinct_tasks_per_criterion": 3,
        "min_independent_successes_per_criterion": 1,
        "min_successes_per_criterion": 3,
        "require_production_tier": true,
        "require_verified_independent_attestation": true
      },
      "external_quorum": {
        "bridge_attestor_must_be_third_identity": true,
        "distinct_public_keys_required": true,
        "min_independent_groups_per_criterion": 2,
        "producer_may_not_be_evaluator": true
      },
      "handoff": {
        "evaluator_must_supply": [
          "independently controlled verifier identity and Ed25519 public key registration",
          "independently frozen hidden-suite id/version/hash",
          "fresh suite-bound challenge",
          "raw evaluation artifacts and result digests",
          "signed production attestations with preserved failures",
          "signed attestation metadata observed_system_manifest_sha256 identifying the runtime manifest actually observed during evaluation"
        ],
        "repository_must_not_supply": [
          "evaluator private key",
          "hidden task answers",
          "bridge trust secret",
          "fabricated production results"
        ]
      },
      "provenance_protocol": {
        "allowed_source_kinds": [
          "external_test",
          "independent_reproduction",
          "human_audit"
        ],
        "bridge_secret_out_of_band_required": true,
        "challenge_bound_to_suite_sha256": true,
        "external_ledger_audit_required": true,
        "fresh_challenge_issued_before_evaluation": true,
        "heldout_disclosure_history_required": true,
        "hidden_suite_frozen_before_run": true,
        "raw_artifact_sha256_required": true,
        "result_sha256_required": true,
        "runtime_system_manifest_required": true,
        "schema_version": 1,
        "signature_algorithm": "ed25519",
        "signed_observed_system_manifest_required": true
      },
      "request_kind": "strict-independent-agi-evaluation-request",
      "request_sha256": "2583352beea7765617606ed39985a0f7e79c45d0256982b7ad4eb4063586505d",
      "required_criteria": [
        "breadth",
        "transfer",
        "autonomy",
        "continual_learning",
        "self_improvement",
        "robustness"
      ],
      "schema_version": 1,
      "subject": {
        "artifact_sha256": "797a0550bada9a7453efd6cb9c4e353be3ea36a3a8dce109df560750d38bd78d",
        "commit_sha": "f5f983604f8b7f4bb6ca4e8fc8f2523f7b88239f",
        "producer_id": "o-work-recovery-v3",
        "repository": "bachikoljunior-blip/O",
        "system_manifest_sha256": "aca8070052a24366c544fd1788dc4a705f42f878acc9d10b82b5a14063516735"
      }
    }
  ],
  "challenges": [],
  "disclosures": [],
  "attestations": []
}

{
  "agi_claim_supported": false,
  "applicability": [
    "Planning comparisons that separately track solved coverage, expansions, pushes and walking cost",
    "Prospective evaluation of bundled interventions with explicit attribution limits",
    "Future Root selection after this exact bounded unit"
  ],
  "candidate_actions": [],
  "candidates": [],
  "claim_boundary": "Same-session internal post-task learning over retained evidence only; no new experiment, independent evaluation, activation or user-goal completion.",
  "conflicts": [],
  "costs_and_risks": [
    "Additional internal lifecycle records and CI latency do not themselves reduce uncertainty about external general capability.",
    "Reusing this already-observed target as a new held-out test would contaminate evaluation.",
    "Ablation or transfer would require a separately precommitted future protocol; none is performed by this Learn."
  ],
  "decision": "NO_CHANGE",
  "dependencies": [],
  "next": "Publish and consume this exact Learn once, then return to Root to select a materially different safe falsifiable effect from latest authority. Do not rerun the six planning trials or infer that the upper objective is achieved.",
  "non_applicability": [
    "General or independent capability claims from three known public records",
    "Retrospective repair of missing historical data",
    "Automatic Candidate activation or replay of these six trials"
  ],
  "reason": "Retain the useful cost and attribution distinctions without proposing a duplicate or unvalidated mechanism. No candidate change is supported by this frozen evidence.",
  "retained_learning": [
    "At the exact locked Boxoban source and first three hard records, the fixed A* reverse-push-assignment/static-dead-square-pruning bundle reduced expanded states relative to UCS in all three pairs. All six saved plans replayed legally; this is bounded algorithmic evidence, not learned transfer.",
    "Push counts matched within each pair, but level0 walking rose from54 to62. Reduced expansions must not be described as dominance across every cost. Single sub-second timings are descriptive; no population latency estimate follows.",
    "Because heuristic and pruning changed together, their separate effects are unidentified. Three public levels with unknown model exposure do not establish held-out generalization, independence, production capability or AGI.",
    "Task Evaluate's scoped unit PASS and original task FAIL remain separate. The planning-scope dual-verdict overlay remains REMAIN_CANDIDATE; there was no matched active-prompt counterfactual or measured comparative benefit supporting activation.",
    "The canonical Episode carries an append-only correction: seven, not eight, planning-related fragments were inspected, out of216 supplied fragments. The frozen Consolidate response is unchanged. Its original pending-consume fields describe the pre-consumption time, not current execution state; snapshot225 proves subsequent consolidation.",
    "Prior Twisted repair-transfer NOT_EVALUABLE, evaluation UNCERTAIN, unknown baseline exit code and unmet source/independence checks remain scoped to that retained trial. Earlier ARC narrow positives remain preserved by immutable history references.",
    "Consolidate was consumed once and published with exact-head CI and nine main readbacks in PR556. Those validate engineering durability, not new external capability. Repeated publication/record growth alone does not justify a new learning mechanism."
  ],
  "reviewed_existing_candidates": [
    {
      "decision": "unchanged_REMAIN_CANDIDATE",
      "id": "candidate-task-evaluate-unit-verdict-v1",
      "reason": "Current outcome preserves dual verdicts but supplies no matched efficacy/cost comparison.",
      "scope": "agi/behavioral-evidence/generation33-external-sokoban-planning-comparison-v1"
    },
    {
      "decision": "unchanged",
      "id": "candidate-agi-benchmark-suite-v1",
      "reason": "Existing capability-evaluation Candidate already covers evaluation design; this three-level fixed algorithm comparison does not establish a new activation case."
    },
    {
      "decision": "unchanged",
      "id": "candidate-self-application-context-hygiene-v1",
      "reason": "No new context-hygiene or independent-boundary comparison occurred; no duplicate Candidate."
    }
  ],
  "reviewed_history_refs": [
    ".continual/episodes/episode-work-recovery-gen9-durability-repair/episode.json",
    ".continual/runs/run-work-recovery-gen9-durability-repair/artifacts/post-task-learn.json",
    ".continual/candidates/candidate-task-evaluate-unit-verdict-v1/candidate.json",
    ".continual/candidates/candidate-agi-benchmark-suite-v1/candidate.json"
  ],
  "rollback_conditions": [
    "No mechanism or active prompt changes; no activation rollback is needed.",
    "Revise scoped inferences on contradictory exact-source evidence while retaining original immutable observations."
  ],
  "task_completion_verdict": "FAIL",
  "upper_objective_achieved": false
}
